flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx (WORKORDER tab sits in a commented-out block), ReportListWorkOrder.tsx (grid stub with no resource), Report/index.tsx (MetaReport); ocmsadminui NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts (notice search by warrant_no against the warrantofarrest endpoint); ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties:23. No work order code in ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi
note: Story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given). The story asks for a review screen with the full list of IDs for the work order including warrant issued date, past visit date(s), warrant number, notice number and address. No code exists for this. The only trace of work orders is a report stub in the staff UI: the 'Workorder Reports' tab sits inside a commented-out JSX block (ReportList.tsx:147-201), so it cannot be opened, and its grid uses an empty resource (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:48) with columns notice_no, vehicle_no, ref_num, source, is_converted, date_time_received, other_info, not the columns the story asks for. Notice search by warrant_no (useSearch.ts:68-78) calls /warrantofarrest and /v1/warrantofarrest is listed in api-authorization.properties:23, but no Java controller for that path was found in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi (grep for warrantofarrest/warrant_no in java src is empty), and it is not a work order list anyway. The warrant model has no past visit date field (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts). No matching maintenance ticket (grep work order/warrant/tagging/house visit in maintenance_tickets.csv: 0).
recommendation: Do not claim. There is no work order review screen; only a hidden report stub. Ask URA/the team whether the work order feature was built outside these six repos.

steps.step: Tagging officer has already selected the address for IDs with multiple addresses (result of OCMS34.10)
steps.detail: No screen or state for address selection in a work order. Case-insensitive grep across the six repos for work order / workorder / work_order / house visit / visit date / service provider / special indicator / validity period / multiple address: no backend code and no staff page; the only 'workorder' hit is a report stub in ocmsadminui (see ReportList.tsx:147-201 and ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:25-75). The address selection feature belongs to OCMS34.10 and is not claimed here.

steps.step: OCMS displays on screen the full list of IDs generated for the work order
steps.detail: The 'Workorder Reports' tab exists but sits inside a commented-out JSX block (ReportList.tsx:147-201 opens '{/* <TabItem' at line 147 and closes '</TabItem> */}' at line 201), so it is not rendered. The ReportListWorkOrder component uses resource={""} (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:48) so no data is fetched. No backend endpoint produces a work order ID list.

steps.step: Each record shows warrant issued date, past visit date(s), warrant number, summons/notice number and address
steps.detail: The stub grid columns are only notice_no, vehicle_no, ref_num, source, is_converted, date_time_received, other_info (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:53-68), with no warrant date, warrant number, past visit date or address. The Iwarrantofarrest model has warrant_issue_date and warrant_no (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts) but no past visit date field, and it is only a UI type. No Java warrantofarrest entity/controller was found in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi.

steps.step: Tagging officer reviews the list before moving on to amend the work order
steps.detail: No review screen can be opened and no follow-on action (remove/add record) exists from it; see OCMS34.12. Case-insensitive grep across the six repos for work order / workorder / work_order / house visit / visit date / service provider / special indicator / validity period / multiple address: no backend code and no staff page; the only 'workorder' hit is a report stub in ocmsadminui (see ReportList.tsx:147-201 and ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:25-75).
